body: Orchestrator review of PR #328 (dotfiles-T128-playbook-rules-a04 with its amendment 1, the INV-6 successor of a01 to a03; T703 under plan 010 D, plan 012 B and plan 017 G″) at its final head: home/dot_agents/skills/agmsg-orchestration/SKILL.md (the dispatch-evidence sentences with the design's 20-minute idle figure and the read refused at its limit, the amendment rule, the three-repeat procedure, the row unit with one row per concrete changed file under an executed or applied wildcard, the invariant check comparing ids and sentences byte-for-byte with the design, the gate command's ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE), AGENTS.md's trust-boundary review bullet, tests/unit/test_agmsg_orchestration_docs.py's token tests and the regime fixtures; outside .orchestration/. Each sentence follows the a04 items as amended against the design on main (INV-2 line 56, INV-10 line 64); no sentence states an unlanded mechanism as present (three-repeat.sh and bus-read.sh are on main since a03c1daa; the invariant sentence check is by hand until a checker lands); the token tests pin each new sentence and pass in CI; the Bot's threads on the final head and the local review's findings are each fixed in the head, refuted with evidence, or owned by dotfiles-T128-playbook-rules-followup-a01 on main; INV-2 caps hold. Approved for the gate at the audited head.
